title: Migrate to S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition
description: Move SAP financial systems (FI, CO) from on-premise ECC 6.0 to cloud-based S/4HANA with integrated reporting platform. Expected to reduce infrastructure costs by 40% and improve system availability.

business_drivers: Enable faster deployment of financial enhancements
Achieve cloud-ready architecture for future innovations

technical_details.technical_approach: Direct migration with data transformation. Leverage SAP standard financial processes. Reporting via SAP Analytics Cloud with federated model.

risks_known: Integration with legacy accounting system complexity
User adoption risk for new cloud interface
dependencies: CHG-2026-003 (Reporting enhancement - blocked until analytics platform ready)
